title: Menopause brain fog isn't dementia — Priya, 47 (myth flip)
caption:
Myth: menopause brain fog means early dementia.
SWAN followed 2,362 women (Neurology, 2009): the dip lands in perimenopause, and memory largely rebounds after.
Which myth next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#menopause #perimenopause #brainfog #womenshealth #menopausesupport #midlifewomen

scenes.text: Everyone told her she was just tired. Nobody mentioned her brain.
phrases: Everyone forgets things at our age.
You're way too young for menopause.
I'm 47. Nobody told me this was my *brain*.
